label: rem:frobenius-dual-h3-remark
title: Degeneracy on H_3 and existence of the Frobenius dual
html:
On H_3 itself the Gram matrix is degenerate: \det G = 0 identically, the (1^3) block being the radical of the Markov trace (MarkovGramDegenerate.lean). Non-degeneracy therefore holds on H_3/\mathrm{rad} \cong \mathrm{TL}_3 and not on H_3.

The dual exists and is unique by non-degeneracy of G on that quotient: the pairing \langle K^\vee, b_j \rangle_F = \sum_{i,k} c_i (G^{-1})_{ik} G_{kj} = \sum_i c_i \delta_{ij} = c_j follows from G^{-1} G = I.
heading: Remark
